facts.fact: Leader Networks surveyed nearly 300 U.S. marketing and community leaders in November 2016.

facts.fact: In the Leader Networks survey, 92% of respondents believed their community had a positive effect on the business.

facts.fact: A research study of 358 online brand community members found that browsing, rather than participation alone, had a positive relationship with brand loyalty.

facts.fact: One 2025 industry analysis reported that 24% of organizations with active community programs could quantify their financial impact, up from 16% the previous year.
